# A trigger fires a node whose handler is empty as it fires any other: it
# runs nothing, and the test goes on.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        button #k(text="k", @click {})
        if shown {
            button #q(text="q", @click {})
        }
        button #j(text="j{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
    }
}

func testEmptyHandlers(t Test, c main) {
    c.k.click()
    if c.q != null {
        c.q.click()
    }
    c.j.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
}

window {
    main
}
